scientific_integrity: The all-width proof uses Fourier-character pair counting, a four-type Walsh identity and exact ternary character-count balancing; finite exhaustive checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Three independent row characters and n independent column characters, n>=3, unit coefficients; binary and ternary phase sets. No higher-row, finite-grid-aliasing or other-alphabet assertion; historical priority has not been independently settled.
title: Sharp binary–ternary phase diagram for bilinear Fourier fourth moments
